title: Project Organica v0.10.0 — the frozen Organica 1 engine and the evidence produced under it
description: The archival release of Project Organica. `organica/` is the engine: a memory store, a sleep service that grows typed structural candidates across cycles, and the laws the engine is meant to satisfy. The engine is frozen at v0.9.0 and is not modified by later work; under this tag it is byte-identical to the v0.9.0 tag apart from the package version string. The release carries that engine together with the evidence produced under it: the belief-revision comparison against simple baselines (Phase K), the plasticity-coherence sweep (Phase L), the acquisition-benchmark audits, the Gate 13 relation-ranking analyses, the formation-versus-utilization campaign, and the candidate-membership audit that reconstructed that campaign's candidate population. The engine uses only the Python standard library.
notes: Deposited from the GitHub release v0.10.0. Organica 1 is frozen: the engine under this tag is byte-identical to the v0.9.0 tag apart from the package version string, and the v0.9.0 tag remains the archival reference for the engine alone. v0.10.0 is the release of the research package around that engine -- the instruments, the evidence artifacts and the two preprint manuscripts -- and none of it modifies the engine.
